metadata.note: No connective, no cue, three complete sentences: 'Kartımı bloke edin.' / 'Dün akşamdan beri bulamıyorum.' / 'Az önce çantamda buldum, gerek kalmadı.' Nothing in the first two says more is coming, so waiting cannot be demanded — what is demanded is that the END state matches the whole turn. A model that blocked on sentence one owes the caller an undo it cannot perform.
